liu: RFC follow-up 1 1 Need an operator cutover playbook for migrating customers off the shared peering mesh into per-tenant ephemeral relays while keeping control-plane separation intact. Goals: preserve client src IP where feasible, avoid exhausting relay leases during spikes, ensure controlplane API affinity remains <1min degraded, and provide deterministic rollback. Please propose concise operator steps + exact commands.

meera: +1. Also include cert rotation handoff for relays (relay certs come from controlplane CA). we need a verify step: certs present and trust chain valid before promoting.

tony: high-level phased plan I like: 1) preflight (snat, long sessions, cp-affinity) 2) reserve and pin ephemeral leases (affinity groups) 3) create relay with CP-side cert and mark as CP-affine 4) warm + cert-verify 5) canary weight shift (1%,5%,25%,100%) tied to lease-available thresholds 6) sticky promotion with optional lease-refresh 7) slow reclaim and CP routing prune.

devon: concrete preflight checks (opsctl):
```bash
# preflight: check snat preference, active long sessions, cp-affinity
opsctl customer preflight --customer=cust-302 --fields=snat,active_sessions,cp_affinity --ticket=INC-2026-3302
```

meera: reserve pinned leases (use affinity labels to preserve srcip when possible):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" -d '{"customer":"cust-302","count":40,"region":"ap-northeast-1","affinity_group":"cust-302-aff1","purpose":"cutover-2026-03"}'
```

liu: relay creation and cert handshake: create relay with controlplane cert request, wait for cert issuance, then verify chain:
```bash
opsctl relay create --name=rel-apn1-14 --region=ap-northeast-1 --customer=cust-302 --cp-affine=true --ticket=INC-2026-3302
# wait for cert
opsctl relay cert-wait --relay=rel-apn1-14 --timeout=120
opsctl relay cert-verify --relay=rel-apn1-14 --ticket=INC-2026-3302
```

tony: warm probes and health gating: run active probes and check tcp handshake+tls verify 200/200 required before canary.

devon: canary ramp commands (weight-based, tied to lease pool):
```bash
# 1% canary
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-302 --target=rel-apn1-14 --weight=1 --ticket=INC-2026-3302
# follow metrics for 10m, then
opsctl route modify --customer=cust-302 --target=rel-apn1-14 --weight=5 --ticket=INC-2026-3302
# then 25% -> 100% once stable
```

meera: autoscaling/eviction policy during ramp: if egress.lease_pool_available < 15% then automatically: reduce canary weight by 50%, trigger controller autoscale, and mark eviction candidates = non-sticky short-TTL leases first. Define rule in monitoring:
```yaml
# rule (human-readable)
when lease_pool_available < 15% -> run autoscale-hook && opsctl route modify --customer=$CUST --target=$RELAY --weight=$(max(1,current_weight/2))
```

liu: promotion (sticky) with CP-affinity tag and optional refresh endpoint for long sessions:
```bash
opsctl route promote --customer=cust-302 --target=rel-apn1-14 --sticky-ttl=1200 --cp-affine=true --ticket=INC-2026-3302
# relay lease refresh (relay calls operator to extend active sticky leases)
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/egress/v1/leases/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_TOKEN" -d '{"lease_id":"lease-foo","extend_seconds":1200}'
```

devon: rollback quick path (single command and autoscale if needed):
```bash
opsctl route rollback --customer=cust-302 --to=shared-peering --ticket=INC-2026-3302
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/egress-operator --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy egress-operator -o jsonpath='{.status.availableReplicas}')+3))
```

ops-bot: ALERT: lease_pool_available for cust-302 dropped to 13% (threshold 15%). Triggering autoscale hook INC-2026-3302.

meera: operator checklist summary for on-call (condensed):
1) run preflight (opsctl customer preflight)
2) reserve pinned leases with affinity groups
3) create relay + wait cert issuance + cert-verify
4) warm probes 200/200
5) canary ramp (1,5,25,100) monitor for 10-15m per step
6) promote with --sticky-ttl + enable lease-refresh for long sessions
7) if lease_pool_available < 15% -> reduce weight, trigger autoscale, prefer evict non-sticky leases
8) rollback = opsctl route rollback -> shared-peering; scale controllers if needed

liu: action items: devon -> add cert-wait + cert-verify into opsctl (QUIC/TLS checks), tony -> implement auto-weight-reduction hook in monitoring, meera -> document affinity_group naming and auditor fields. keep replies short.
